
# Magnus Bergmark

> Magnus Bergmark is an Executive Director – Strategy & Consulting at Valtech in Stockholm, Sweden, with 20+ years of experience building businesses, digital products, innovation capabilities and new ventures across strategy, technology and consulting.

## Professional focus

Magnus works at the intersection of business strategy, technology, innovation and execution. His experience includes:

- Business strategy and corporate strategy
- Strategy consulting
- Digital transformation
- Innovation strategy and management
- Product strategy and product development
- New business development
- Venture building and venture investment
- Technology strategy
- Data and AI
- Organizational transformation
- Leadership and team building

## Career

Magnus has held senior roles across consulting, entrepreneurship, venture building, innovation and telecommunications.

His career includes:

- **Valtech** — Executive Director, Strategy & Consulting
- **Telia Company / Division X** — strategy, new product and innovation leadership
- **Telia xLABS** — innovation and venture development
- **Forward & Friends** — venture building and investment
- **EY Doberman** — strategy, design, product and business development
- **Investment AB Latour** — investment and business development
- **Moonwalk** — co-founder and entrepreneur

A recurring theme throughout his career is building: businesses, products, teams, innovation capabilities and new ventures.

## Selected experience

Magnus has experience with both strategic and hands-on work, including launching new businesses and products, developing innovation portfolios, building teams and organizations, and working with technology-driven transformation.

At Moonwalk, he was a co-founder and helped grow the company to approximately 18 employees and around SEK 20 million in turnover.

At Telia, his work included product strategy, new business development, innovation and data-driven products such as Telia Smart Drones and Telia Crowd Insights.

## Current role

Magnus is currently Executive Director – Strategy & Consulting at Valtech, based in Stockholm.

## Location

Stockholm, Sweden.

## Personal projects

Outside his professional work, Magnus builds physical and digital projects. These include electronics and IoT projects, 3D printing, custom hardware, software and other maker projects.
